acceptance: Report ordinary versus V8 at all matched steps, step590, and minimum-dev-patient-equal selected checkpoints. No interim test-based changes or stopping.
api_stream_retry: Each attempt has a600s total wall deadline. Timeouts, stream_read_error, SDK APIConnectionError, httpx network and remote-protocol disconnections retry an identical request; at most3 attempts with2s delay and immutable receipts. Invalid outputs are not retried.
checkpoint_acceptance: fixed training-step/time endpoints; latest completed result at each endpoint, not best test CER
checkpoint_save_order: Save adapter, optimizer, scheduler, rank RNG, sampler and dev reflection context before any post-evaluation Agent call.
checkpoint_selection: Minimum dev patient-equal CER including the fresh starting model; ties keep earlier checkpoint.
evaluation: greedy Cantonese, empty context, cap256, original batches of8, BF16 merged adapters with exact base restore
historical_test_exposure: These held-out recordings were examined in historical experiments; not a new blind test.
mas_sampling: Choose group by Agent probabilities, then selected versus full group pool with replacement; empty selected group retains full group pool exposure.
only_agent_action: Select real recording IDs, six group exposure probabilities, and a shared within-group selected probability.
requested_change: Transfer unchanged V8 curriculum to UCG: patient overlap, held-out complete text; adapt split validation and dataset explanation only. Four GPUs sequentially per branch, global batch32 unchanged.
test_use: report only; no test transcripts, scores or patient metadata are included in MAS requests or experience
time_comparison: Both branches each use four L20 GPUs sequentially and590 updates. Report matched steps and latest completed evaluation at common elapsed wall time including model load, evaluations and API waits.
uniform_control: continuous shuffled traversal without replacement; full global batches may cross traversal boundaries
runtime_fix: Measure dev focus cohorts using ephemeral dev phonology profiles, independent of train-only retrieval index. No new training materials or changed sampling/optimization.
material_adaptation: Only Material Agent gets dev-derived patient/focus counts and shared target syllables. Original candidate eligibility, shortlist, diagnosis, scheduler, reflection, optimizer and budget unchanged.
